title: Primeape Can Get So Angry, It Dies
premise: Primeape can become so angry that it dies, yet its face looks peaceful afterward.
audiencePromise: Watch Primeape’s rage build toward a deathly calm transformation.
openLoop: What does Primeape look like when its anger finally ends?
payoff: Primeape’s fury can end in death, but its final expression is peaceful.
engagementQuestion: Is that tragic, or somehow peaceful?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a disturbing surprise. Start sharp, build tension quickly, then slow slightly for the peaceful reveal. Keep the final question playful and genuinely divided.

scenes.headline: RAGE CAN KILL PRIMEAPE
scenes.narration: Primeape can get so angry, it dies.
scenes.caption: ANGER REACHES THE LIMIT

scenes.headline: ANGER MAKES IT STRONGER
scenes.narration: Its fury boosts its muscles, but dulls its mind.
scenes.caption: MORE POWER. LESS INTELLIGENCE.

scenes.headline: THE RAGE GOES TOO FAR
scenes.narration: The Pokédex says extreme anger can cause Primeape’s death.
scenes.caption: ANGER BECOMES FATAL

scenes.headline: THEN ITS FACE GOES PEACEFUL
scenes.narration: Then comes the strangest part: its face looks peaceful.
scenes.caption: RAGE ENDS IN CALM

scenes.headline: THE FURY FINALLY STOPS
scenes.narration: After death, Primeape’s usually furious face looks peaceful instead.
scenes.caption: NO FURY. JUST CALM.

scenes.headline: TRAGIC OR PEACEFUL?
scenes.narration: Is that tragic, or somehow peaceful?
scenes.caption: WHICH WAY DO YOU SEE IT?
